title: True Momentum
tagline: Turning an AI pipeline into a real product
description: I built the full-stack web application around an existing AI revenue-diagnostic pipeline. I designed and developed the user-facing experience, diagnostic flow, backend, payments, and supporting product infrastructure needed to turn the underlying system into something customers could actually use.

detail.problem: The client already had the core AI analysis pipeline, but needed a proper product around it. The challenge was turning that underlying technology into a clear, trustworthy experience that could take a user from the initial assessment through to the final service.
detail.solution: I built the web application around the existing pipeline, including the landing pages, diagnostic experience, user flows, backend functionality, and payment integration. Rather than simply presenting the AI as a technical demo, I turned it into a complete customer-facing product designed around how someone would actually use the service.

title: Auspec Pharma
tagline: A complete digital platform for a pharmaceutical company
description: I built a full-stack website for Auspec Pharma with a public product and company portfolio, working contact system, and an internal admin portal. The admin system lets the team manage products and vacancies themselves and generate QR codes that link directly to digital product leaflets hosted in the cloud.

detail.problem: The company needed an initial professional web presence, but also needed more than a static website. Product information, hiring vacancies, and medicine leaflets needed to be managed and updated without having to rebuild the site every time something changed.
detail.solution: I built both the public website and the management system behind it. Authorized admins can add and update products, manage hiring vacancies, upload product leaflets, and generate QR codes for those leaflets to be placed on medicine packaging. This gives the company a single system for presenting its products publicly while managing its content internally.

title: FlexPlus
description: I built a browser extension that completely overhauls the FAST student portal without requiring any changes to the university's system. It replaces the cluttered interface with a cleaner experience and adds features like a prerequisite checker, SGPA/CGPA simulator, and total-fee calculator.

detail.problem: The original student portal was difficult to navigate and often displayed important information in a confusing way. Students had to work around the interface just to do simple things like check grades, plan courses, or understand their fees.
detail.solution: I built FlexPlus to work on top of the existing portal. Once the original page loads, the extension reconstructs the interface into a cleaner layout and adds tools that weren't available in the original system. It required no access to the university's backend and was built independently, eventually reaching around 1,000 users.

title: MailMind
tagline: Your inbox, turned into a to-do list
description: An AI email assistant I built to turn a busy inbox into useful, structured information. It identifies tasks, meetings, orders, and other important details from emails, then prepares replies and organizes everything in one place.

detail.problem: Important information is often buried inside an inbox. A simple email can contain a task, a meeting, an order, or something that needs a reply, but keeping track of all of it manually takes time.
detail.solution: I built MailMind as an intelligent layer on top of Gmail. It reads incoming emails, identifies what matters, extracts the useful information, turns it into structured items, and can prepare replies for the user to review. The project was later paused as Gmail began offering many of these capabilities itself, but it gave me hands-on experience building an AI product around real-world email workflows.

title: Sepsis Analysis
description: I built a machine-learning pipeline that analyzes incomplete ICU patient data to identify patterns associated with sepsis before clinical onset. The project focuses on making sense of the messy, irregular data that real-world patient monitoring produces.

detail.problem: ICU data isn't recorded neatly. Vital signs and other measurements can have large gaps, arrive at irregular intervals, and contain missing information, making it difficult to build reliable models for early detection.
detail.solution: I built a pipeline that cleans and fills gaps in the data, creates useful time-based features, and looks for changes in a patient's condition over time. The resulting model uses these patterns to flag patients who may be approaching sepsis, turning incomplete ICU records into an early-warning signal.

title: Lookbook Cropper
tagline: A smarter media workflow for e-commerce
description: I'm building a media management platform for e-commerce teams to organize their product assets and create marketing content from them. The platform combines product media management with AI-powered tools for generating ads and other content relevant to a brand's style.

detail.problem: E-commerce teams often have product images, lookbooks, marketing assets, and other media scattered across different files and folders. Turning those assets into properly organized product media and marketing material can involve a lot of repetitive manual work.
detail.solution: I'm building a platform that brings the entire media workflow into one place. It can process product lookbooks, help extract and organize product imagery, manage media assets, and use AI to generate advertising material based on the products and the brand's visual style. The platform is currently under development.

title: House of Lawn
tagline: A complete online store for a fashion retailer
description: I customized and built out a Shopify e-commerce store for House of Lawn, organizing roughly 1,000 products into a structured online catalog. I helped model the products, collections, brands, and variants and set up the shopping experience so customers can browse and purchase directly online.

detail.problem: The business needed a properly structured online store capable of handling a large fashion catalog. With hundreds of products and multiple brands and collections, simply putting products online wasn't enough—the store needed a structure that made browsing and shopping straightforward.
detail.solution: I customized a Shopify storefront and built out its product structure around the business's catalog. I helped organize the products, collections, brands, variants, images, and pricing, while configuring the store's shopping flow so the business could manage its catalog and customers could browse and purchase products online.
